articles.title: Coldcard hack sparks biggest sub-1 BTC move since FTX: CryptoQuant
articles.snippet: Bitcoin users moved 39,600 BTC in small transactions as the Coldcard hack continued, with researchers warning that the attack remained active.

articles.title: Trump Family’s American Bitcoin Tops 8,000 BTC After Record Mining Quarter
articles.snippet: The Hut 8 subsidiary increased its Bitcoin holdings by 14% in the second quarter even as Bitcoin’s price fell.

articles.title: CZ Warns Bitcoin Holders After $70 Million Wallet Exploit: 'Nothing Is 100%'
articles.snippet: The Binance founder urged holders to spread funds across multiple wallets as Galaxy Research put the toll from the Coldcard exploit at roughly $70 million—nearly double the initial estimate.

articles.title: Claude Hacked Three Companies in Internal Testing: Anthropic
articles.snippet: Anthropic says three Claude models compromised the companies after a testing misconfiguration exposed the AI to the public internet.

articles.title: Coinbase Misses on Q2 Earnings as Crypto Trading Activity Slows
articles.snippet: The exchange reported lower quarterly revenue and a net loss as crypto trading activity declined, while subscription, stablecoin, and lending businesses continued to grow.
